title: Bitcoin risks falling below $60,000 as Nvidia earnings threaten to deepen crypto sell-off
content: Rising bond yields, ETF outflows and forced selling are weighing on bitcoin as traders brace for more losses.

title: U.S. Senate Democrats tell CFTC to back off its demand prediction markets defy bans
content: The Commodity Futures Trading Commission directed platforms such as Kalshi to defy state bans, but the Democrats want it to reverse course, citing court orders.

title: Lighter suspends all withdrawals after $10.4 million crypto exploit
content: The decentralized exchange blamed a leaked trading API key and said its smart contracts were unaffected, while investigators traced funds to Hyperliquid.

title: Brazil's central bank faces backlash over stablecoin money laundering remarks
content: A central bank official reportedly said legitimate funds become tainted when moved into stablecoins, comparing the market to the informal "dólar-cabo" system.

title: German parliament proposes crypto seizures without criminal charges
content: German lawyers said a proposed law allowing the seizure of assets worth more than 100,000 euros could impose a burden of proof on crypto holders rather than the authorities.

title: Boris Johnson says UK must lead blockchain development despite crypto doubts
content: Johnson was joined by Lord Ross Kempsell who called for regulators to work with industry participants to bring the UK to the forefront.

title: Coinbase and Broadridge propose standard for tokenized stock disclosures
content: The proposed standard aims to connect tokenized stockholders with corporate disclosures and voting materials across digital wallets, but would not create shareholder rights.

title: Nvidia turmoil tests Bitcoin miners’ AI funding plans
content: Nvidia’s leadership upheaval and Texas permit restrictions sharpen the divide between miners with funded projects and those still seeking capital and approvals.

title: Safe wallet reportedly loses $6.5M as Zodiac suspects key compromise
content: Zodiac’s co-founder said a likely compromised key and overly permissive wallet settings enabled the theft, rather than a flaw in its smart contracts.

title: Bitcoin price fails to hold $65K as US stocks drop further on AI nerves
content: Bitcoin and US equities saw pressure to start the week as traders weighed the impact of forthcoming Nvidia Q3 earnings and Anthropic’s IPO announcement.

title: Tom Lee Blames Nvidia and Anthropic IPO for Ethereum Plunge as Bitmine Buys the Dip
content: The firm’s stash fell to $11.8 billion from $14.3 billion a week earlier as ETH slid 28% in two weeks, a “waterfall” drop chairman Tom Lee blames on Nvidia fallout and cash-raising ahead of Anthropic’s IPO.

title: Clarity Act Defeat ‘Failure of American Leadership’: Trump’s Former Crypto Chief
content: Former White House crypto chief Patrick Witt said the Clarity Act "lost against the clock," and regulators will now set the rules.

title: Trump Backs Jensen Huang’s Return to Nvidia as Sam Altman Says 'Heroes Have Flaws'
content: Trump would welcome Nvidia’s co-founder back. Altman, who survived his own CEO ouster, sympathizes but stops short of endorsing Huang’s comeback.

title: Fed Is Modeling AI 'Super Intelligence' Scenarios, Including Job Losses and a Stock Market Slump
content: Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh says staff are studying three possible economic futures for AI, ranging from widespread productivity gains to higher unemployment and a painful correction in technology stocks.

title: Nvidia Stock Has a 20% Rebound in Sight—If Bulls Can Clear a Hurdle
content: Nvidia shares tanked specularly last week amid the Jensen Huang scandal. Is it in for a major rebound? Here’s what the charts suggest.

title: Senate Agriculture Committee to Hear Trump’s CFTC Nominees Tuesday
content: Bitcoin Magazine Senate Agriculture Committee to Hear Trump’s CFTC Nominees Tuesday The Senate Agriculture Committee will hear Nathan Anonick and Matthew Rowland on Tuesday, President Trump's bipartisan picks to join CFTC Chairman Michael Selig, currently the agency's only sitting commissioner. title: $36B Wealth Firm Strategist: Bitcoin’s Supercycle Is “Still Intact”
content: ▶ Bitcoin Magazine $36B Wealth Firm Strategist: Bitcoin’s Supercycle Is “Still Intact” James Thorne, Chief Market Strategist at Wellington-Altus, tells BMTV that Bitcoin's super cycle is still intact after the drop from about 83,000 in mid-October to around 64,000. This post $36B Wealth Firm Strategist: Bitcoin’s Supercycle Is “Still Intact” first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Patrick Green .

title: German Bundestag Lets Customs Freeze Crypto Over €100,000 Without a Criminal Case as the Bill Goes to the Bundesrat
content: Bitcoin Magazine German Bundestag Lets Customs Freeze Crypto Over €100,000 Without a Criminal Case as the Bill Goes to the Bundesrat The Bundestag approved a bill that would let German customs freeze crypto and other assets over €100,000 of unclear origin without a criminal case. Permanent confiscation would still require a court, and the timing of the Bundesrat vote remains unclear. This post German Bundestag Lets Customs Freeze Crypto Over €100,000 Without a Criminal Case as the Bill Goes to the Bundesrat first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .

title: Harvard Holds 3.04 Million Bitcoin ETF Shares Steady
content: Bitcoin Magazine Harvard Holds 3.04 Million Bitcoin ETF Shares Steady Harvard Management Company's latest 13F shows it still holds 3,044,612 shares of BlackRock's iShares Bitcoin Trust, unchanged since March, a stake now worth about $110.6 million after bitcoin's slide. This post Harvard Holds 3.04 Million Bitcoin ETF Shares Steady first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
